title: Aromatic Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: This traditional Algerian dish features tender lamb in a rich and aromatic sauce, cooked to perfection in a clay tagine vessel. The combination of vin santo, smoky spices, and low sodium ingredients creates a truly unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt-free seasoning blend.
Heat the olive oil in the clay tagine vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the vin santo, ground cumin, and smoked paprika, stirring to combine.
Cover the tagine vessel and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped dried apricots and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley over the top of the tagine and serve.
